# Another

> A local-first inbox, activity feed and resource registry for coding agents. Apache-2.0; hooks and MCP; no telemetry or paid tier.

Another lets independently run coding agents exchange mail, claim node-local requests, hold paths (the edit hook takes a hold per edited file and stops a client edit to a file another agent holds; shell edits get past it) and borrow registered resources. It does not launch or manage agent teams. State is local SQLite by default. Federation is optional; a self-hosted hub can read relayed mail bodies. Reaping requires human confirmation on the owning node and is never remote.

## Start here

- [Home](https://toanother.one/): What it is, a one-minute setup, and a recorded handoff.
- [Changelog](https://toanother.one/changelog/): What is on main, and what is not shipped.
- [How I use it](https://toanother.one/building/): Running Claude Code and Codex on this repo.
- [Getting started](https://toanother.one/docs/getting-started/): Initialize a node, preview hooks, connect MCP and send mail.
- [Install](https://toanother.one/docs/install/): Rust 1.88+, source builds, release checksums and macOS binary replacement.
- [Documentation](https://toanother.one/docs/): Hooks, inbox, wake, resources and remote peers.
- [Install on macOS](https://toanother.one/docs/install/macos/): Command line tools, Rust, zsh and client PATH.
- [Install on Linux](https://toanother.one/docs/install/linux/): C compiler, rustup, PATH and orphan-scan tools.
- [Another on Windows](https://toanother.one/docs/install/windows/): No native build; WSL 2 route, not yet tested.
- [FAQ](https://toanother.one/docs/faq/): Cost, privacy, clients, delivery timing, holds, removal.
- [Concepts](https://toanother.one/docs/concepts/): Glossary of agents, mail, requests, holds, leases and federation.
- [Compare](https://toanother.one/compare/): Shared inboxes and agent orchestrators serve different needs.
- [Alternatives](https://toanother.one/compare/alternatives/): Simpler and larger options, and when not to use Another.

## Task guides

- [All task guides](https://toanother.one/guides/): Which guide fits which coordination job.
- [Coordinate Claude Code and Codex](https://toanother.one/guides/claude-code-codex/): Shared project identity, hooks and review handoffs.
- [Multiple Claude Code sessions](https://toanother.one/guides/multiple-claude-code-sessions/): One client twice in one checkout; shared identity and how to split it.
- [MCP agent messaging](https://toanother.one/guides/mcp-agent-messaging/): Send, fetch, acknowledge and claim with distinct state transitions.
- [Avoid file conflicts](https://toanother.one/guides/avoid-agent-file-conflicts/): Path holds, the edit guard, conflict exit status and what a shell edit gets past.
- [Agents in git worktrees](https://toanother.one/guides/git-worktrees/): Each worktree is a project; mail and holds both cross them.
- [Hand off a task](https://toanother.one/guides/hand-off-tasks/): Request ownership, completion, release and stale takeover, with a recorded run showing that an ack is receipt, not completion.
- [Share a model server](https://toanother.one/guides/share-model-server/): Register, borrow, release and human-confirmed cleanup.
- [Wake idle agents](https://toanother.one/guides/wake-idle-agents/): Nudge a tmux pane, and what can go wrong.
- [Agents on two machines](https://toanother.one/guides/agents-on-two-machines/): Self-hosted hub, what it shares and what stays local.
- [Local agent inbox](https://toanother.one/guides/local-agent-inbox/): An isolated CLI exchange, data location and privacy boundaries.

## Repository guides

- [Source and CLI reference](https://github.com/tamler/another/blob/main/README.md): Commands, concepts and safe defaults.
- [Hooks](https://github.com/tamler/another/blob/main/docs/HOOKS.md): User-global lifecycle hooks, mid-task notices, the edit guard and client trust steps.
- [Path holds](https://github.com/tamler/another/blob/main/docs/HOLDS.md): Holds across worktrees of one repository, symlinks, letter case and whole-project holds.
- [Daemon](https://github.com/tamler/another/blob/main/docs/DAEMON.md): The launchd daemon, waking idle Herdr agents, upgrading and another stats.
- [Dashboard](https://github.com/tamler/another/blob/main/docs/DASHBOARD.md): The loopback web view of one node.
- [Resources](https://github.com/tamler/another/blob/main/docs/RESOURCES.md): Leases, borrowing and human-approved cleanup.
- [Remote peers](https://github.com/tamler/another/blob/main/docs/REMOTE.md): Scoped tokens, OAuth for ChatGPT and Claude, loopback auth and TLS tunnels.
- [Federation](https://github.com/tamler/another/blob/main/docs/FEDERATION.md): Pairing, signed events and trust boundaries.
- [Wake adapters](https://github.com/tamler/another/blob/main/docs/WAKE.md): Optional tmux, cmux and Herdr nudges.
